input: Frame and hang the gallery wall in hallway

gold.taskTitle: Frame and Hang a Gallery Wall in Hallway
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a gallery wall installation in the hallway, including selecting frames, arranging artwork, and mounting everything securely.

questions.title: How many pieces are going on the wall?
questions.description: Understand the total number of frames or art pieces the user intends to hang.

questions.title: What is the wall's approximate width and height?
questions.description: Get the dimensions of the hallway wall to plan the layout.

questions.title: Are the frames already purchased or still needed?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to shop for frames or already has them.

questions.title: What type of content is going in the frames?
questions.description: Find out if the pieces are photos, prints, paintings, mirrors, or a mix.

questions.title: Do you have a specific layout style in mind?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a grid, salon-style, asymmetric, or another arrangement.

questions.title: What is the wall material — drywall, plaster, or brick?
questions.description: Identify the wall surface to determine the right hardware and tools needed.

questions.title: Is there a deadline for when this should be finished?
questions.description: Understand any time constraint or target completion date for the project.
